opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other institutions of higher education in the UK; on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations defined as eligible by UKRI. The Principal Investigator must be employed by an eligible institution (or be an academic who has maintained close links following retirement), and must take responsibility for directing the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects for researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education. Grants up to £500,000 held for up to five years, with at least 75% of resources used to fund research staff. Assessed via a two-stage process (outline stage currently paused, to be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026; detailed applications from invited applicants accepted by 1 September 2026).

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who coordinates the visit; some specialist arts institutions may also apply. The visitor is an eminent senior professor from overseas. Visitors who previously held a Visiting Professorship can only apply if at least 7 years have elapsed.
opportunities.summary: Enables UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research. Priority given to new or recent collaborations and visits with activities beyond research. Visits last 3-12 months.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers who hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the duration of the Fellowship; resident in the UK at the time of application; permanent member of the UK scholarly community with an established track record. Priority given to those whose teaching and administrative duties have significantly impacted research.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research. Fellowships tenable for 3-24 months, maximum value £70,000. Application materials will be available on the scheme page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks of the year and hold or have held a teaching and/or research post at a UK university with research degree or taught degree awarding powers or an eligible Independent Research Organisation/Institute; retired by the time of commencing the Fellowship; have an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Fellowships tenable for 3-24 months, £3,000 to £24,000. Application materials will be available on the scheme page during September 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible institutions are UK universities defined as institutions registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers. A centre may be based at a single university or be a collaboration between multiple institutions; international participation encouraged. Previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial College London) eligible in this round.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Up to £10 million over up to 10 years. The Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: The awards will be for up to £1 million, for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at lecturer level or equivalent at a UK university (or nominated by a UK university that undertakes to offer a contract); at least two years full-time or equivalent experience in a research or teaching post after PhD; must not have held an equivalent award providing funds to establish an independent research group, held project grant funding over £100k in a single award, or led a team of research staff. Applicants at Senior Lecturer, Reader/Associate Professor or Professor level are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career who need to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. Awards up to £1 million over 4-5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
